Kuvaaja: hiilidioksidin vuosikeskiarvo M: Graph: the annual mean of carbon dioxide at Mauna Loa in 1959–2025 in parts per million (ppm). The horizontal axis is the year, the vertical axis the concentration, and the vertical axis starts at 300 ppm. The curve rises all the time and gets steeper towards the end. The values can be read from the graph, and they are also in the downloadable data.
Kuvaaja: maapallon keskilämpötilan poikk: Graph: the anomaly of the Earth's mean temperature from the mean of 1951–1980 in 1880–2025 (NASA GISTEMP v4). Each year is a bar: a red bar is a year warmer than the reference period, a blue bar a cooler one. A black horizontal line is the mean of each decade. The bars vary from year to year, but the decade means rise every decade from the 1970s on.
Kaksi virtapiiriä piirrosmerkein. Kummas: Two circuits drawn with circuit symbols. Each has a battery on the left with its positive terminal at the top, a switch at the top and a bulb on the right. In the left picture the switch is closed, the circuit is closed and the bulb is lit. Violet arrows show the current I flowing from the positive terminal through the switch and the bulb to the negative terminal. In the right picture the switch is open, the circuit is open, no current flows and the bulb is out.
Ylhäällä sivukuva: kaksi kirjapinoa, joi: At the top a side view: two stacks of books with a 20-centimetre gap between them and a folded paper bridge on top. In the middle of the bridge is a cup, and a red arrow points down: the weight of the coins pushes on the bridge. At the bottom three cross-sections of the same amount of paper: flat paper is low and bends easily, while paper folded into a zigzag and into a channel are taller and carry more.
poikkileikkaukset samasta paperimäärästä: cross-sections of the same amount of paper
A printable cipher wheel in two parts. On the left a big outer wheel with the 29 letters of the Finnish alphabet from A to Ö clockwise round its edge. On the right a smaller inner wheel with the same letters round its edge. The wheels are cut out, the small one is placed on top of the big one and a pin is put through the centre, so that the inner wheel can be turned.
Vasemmalla mustalla taustalla kolme osit: On the left, on a black background, three partly overlapping circles of light: red, green and blue. Where red and green overlap the area is yellow, red and blue give magenta, green and blue give cyan, and in the middle of all three it is white. On the right white light falls on a red film, and only red light gets through the film.
